english.note: Use 零 as the all-purpose word for zero, including the digit 0.
Use this for literal zero or, more loosely, nothing at all; idiomatic sentences such as “know zip about” usually need a different Cantonese sentence.

examples.english: The first character in the code is nought.
examples.jyutping: go3 mat6 maa5 dai6 jat1 go3 zi6 hai6 ling4

examples.english: I got zip points for my homework.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gung1 fo3 lo2 zo2 ling4 fan1
